test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: P, Q and R can complete a work in 10 days, 20 days and 30 days, respectively, working alone. How soon can the work be completed if P is assisted by Q and R on alternate days?
solution:
**Given:**

P, Q, and R can complete a work in 10 days, 20 days, and 30 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency of the workers × time taken by them

Calculation:

LCM of 10, 20, 30 = 60 i.e total work

So,

Efficiency of P = 60/10 = 6 units/
